agents.name: Inventory Watcher
agents.task_text: Every day, check my inventory. Tell me about products that are oversold or set to keep selling when they are out of stock, except anything tagged pre-order or backorder. Show me the change you would make, but do not change anything.

never: Never changes anything in your store: drafts only. Making changes needs a wider permission and a new grant.
Never changes stock quantities.
Never changes product status (draft, active, archived) or deletes anything.
Never invents prices or SKUs: values come only from your files or rules.
Never touches products or fields outside this list.
Never sends email to anyone outside the allowed recipients, even with your approval: adding a recipient needs a new grant.
Never lets an incoming email or attachment change what it is allowed to do.
Never reads your mailbox.
grants: Works on james , on every product in the store.

Overselling: drafts only: will show you the exact change it would make, and never makes it: "Continue selling when out of stock" from On to Off on tracked, active variants. Skips products tagged "preorder", "pre-order", "backorder", "made-to-order", "made to order", products sold through selling plans, gift cards and untracked inventory.
Checks (read only): shopify.oversold_stop_selling. Problems are reported for a person; nothing is changed.

Email from inventory-watcher.51b789@agents.getdeploi.test: may write drafts for you to review; it never sends. Purpose: "Alert the store owner about inventory problems that need a person". Tasks: alert people about problems that need a person.
Email recipients allowed: owner@example.test. Summaries and alerts go to owner@example.test.
limits: Re-reads every record just before writing and stops if it changed; confirms every change with a fresh read.

agents.name: Supplier Chaser
agents.task_text: Every day, find products with 2 or fewer available and draft a restock request to my supplier from your own address. If the supplier has not replied after 3 days, draft one follow-up in the same thread. Do not send anything without me.

Email from supplier-chaser.8b667b@agents.getdeploi.test: may write drafts for you to review; it never sends. Purpose: "Ask the supplier to confirm restock of low-stock products, and follow up once". Tasks: ask a supplier to confirm restock for low-stock products; follow up once, in the same thread, when a supplier has not replied.

Email recipients allowed: supplier@example.test. Supplier requests go to supplier@example.test for variants with 2 or fewer available, at most once every 7 days per variant. If the supplier has not replied after 3 days, one follow-up in the same thread.
Mailbox reading: only to notice replies to messages this agent sent. Reply content is never acted on.
